# Paying employees
## On this page:
- [Minimum wages](https://smallbusiness.fairwork.gov.au/paying-employees#minimum-wages)

## Minimum wages
- award

### Key points
- Many small businesses are covered by their industry award, so it’s important you know what covers your business. For example, the Restaurant Award or Retail Award.

### Resources and tools
- **Awards:** if you’re not sure of your award, use our free 3-step [Find my award tool](https://services.fairwork.gov.au/find-my-award) to work it out. You can also read our step-by-step guide [I'm not sure which award covers my business](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/workplace-problems/common-workplace-problems/im-not-sure-which-award-covers-my-business).

## Deductions and overpayments
### Key points
- An example of a legal deduction is a salary sacrifice arrangement.
